item.title: Petition to give Pacific Grove voters authority in council pay circulates
item.description: According to a press release, Transparent Pacific Grove filed a notice of intent on Feb. 3 to circulate a petition to qualify a charter amendment for the Nov. 3 ballot. The proposed initiative would require voter approval before the mayor or city council members could approve changes to their own compensation or receive city-paid benefits. The requirements would be written directly into the City Charter.
